desc:
HIT BOUT’ IT!
Step into the ring and prove yourself.
Hit Bout’ It! is a physics-based fighting game built around punches, kicks, counters, and reactive combat. Learn your opponent’s timing, find openings, and land your shots. Every fight is a chance to improve.

CONTROLS

PC
* Use your mouse and keyboard to move, aim, attack, and defend.
* Open the emote wheel to taunt or celebrate.

Mobile
* Use the on-screen controls to move, attack, and defend.
* Tap the emote button to use emotes.

Controller
* Use your controller to move, aim, attack, and defend.
* Use the assigned emote control to open the emote wheel.
PUBLIC STRESS TEST
This game is still being tested. You may encounter bugs or balance changes. Please report issues and help us improve the experience.
